inlines.text: 把注意力放在最重要的事情上

blocks.text: 我们将 Claude Duet 设计成一位你可以信赖的伙伴。各类专业人士每天都要应对许多决策，我们认为他们会发现 Claude Duet 最为实用。它帮助你确定该把时间和精力花在哪里，并为那些过去觉得不可能或令人望而生畏的雄心项目留出空间。

blocks.text: Claude Duet 借鉴了多年来在智能体方面的安全、保障与隐私工作，既包括我们自己的成果，也包括企业用来运行其智能体的基础设施：

inlines.text: Claude Duet 借鉴了多年来在智能体方面的安全、保障与隐私工作，既包括我们自己的成果，也包括企业用来运行其智能体的基础设施：
Claude Duet 借鉴了我们
可信智能体框架（在新标签页中打开）
，该框架同样指导着 Claude Code 和 Claude in Chrome 等智能体。

Claude Managed Agents（在新标签页中打开）
采用的设计，因此它永远不会直接看到你的密码或登录令牌。
操作由我们的
自动模式分类器（在新标签页中打开）
批准，这一同样的防护机制保护 Claude 和 Claude Code 不采取你并未要求的步骤。

浏览器使用研究（在新标签页中打开）

我们针对 Claude Duet 的安全基础设施开展对抗性测试。红队和一家外部公司对 Claude Duet 进行了渗透测试，它也被纳入我们公开的
漏洞赏金计划（在新标签页中打开）

blocks.text: Duet 如何处理敏感信息。我们还为 Claude Duet 配备了全新的专用分类器和安全系统提示词，用于检查每条消息并防止敏感信息泄露。一个替你读取邮件并发送消息的智能体，时刻都在判断信息应当流向何处。这套新的分类器和提示词旨在拒绝分享最严格层级信息的请求，包括信用卡号和政府身份证件。其他敏感信息（如健康或个人财务信息）仅在你明确指示 Claude Duet 发送时才会被放行。

blocks.text: Anthropic 的员工一直在使用 Claude Duet 完成更多工作，同时也为自己留出更多思考和专注当下的空间。负责 Claude Code 团队的 Boris Cherny 会在散步时与 Claude Duet 梳理自己的待办清单，而不是把工作留到办公桌前。负责模型与产品行为设计团队的 Chelsea Larsson 会在离开去陪孩子之前把待办清单交给 Claude Duet，它会将结果保存为晚间报告。而 Claude Duet 背后的团队则用它来构建这款产品。团队负责人 Karan Ahuja 用它安排用户访谈、与他一起制作原型，甚至提交代码。

blocks.text: 你在 Claude 中的上下文是基础。Claude Duet 会沿用你 Claude 账户中的记忆、技能和已连接的应用，因此设置几乎无需额外工作。改变的是你们协作的方式：Claude Duet 会主动来找你，你可以通过打字或语音在同一个持续对话中给它发消息，因此一句快速回复和一个为期一周的项目都从同一个地方开始。

It helps you prioritize where to spend your time and energy, and to leave room for the ambitious projects that felt impossible or daunting before.

blocks.text: Claude Duet draws on years of security, safety, and privacy work on agents, both our own and the infrastructure businesses use to run theirs:

inlines.text: Claude Duet draws on years of security, safety, and privacy work on agents, both our own and the infrastructure businesses use to run theirs:
Claude Duet draws on our
framework for trustworthy agents (opens in new tab)
, which also guides agents like Claude Code and Claude in Chrome.
Claude Duet’s handling of credentials follows the design we use for
Claude Managed Agents (opens in new tab)
, so it never directly sees your passwords or sign-in tokens.
Actions are approved by our
auto mode classifier (opens in new tab)
, the same safeguard that protects Claude and Claude Code from taking steps you didn’t ask for.
Claude Duet’s defenses against hidden instructions and prompt injection come from our
browser-use research (opens in new tab)
, and our models and safeguards also cover this more broadly.
We run adversarial tests for Claude Duet’s security infrastructure. Red teams and an external firm penetration tested Claude Duet, and it’s covered by our public
bug bounty program (opens in new tab)

blocks.text: How Duet handles sensitive information. We’re also releasing Claude Duet with a new dedicated classifier and safety system prompt that checks each message and guards against leaks of sensitive information. An agent that reads email and sends messages for you is constantly deciding where information should go. This new classifier and prompt are designed to reject requests to share the strictest tier of information, including credit card numbers and government identification. Other sensitive information, such as health or personal finances, are let through only when you’ve explicitly instructed Claude Duet to send it.

blocks.text: People at Anthropic have been using Claude Duet to accomplish more, but also to leave more room for thinking and being present. Boris Cherny, who leads our Claude Code team, talks through his mental to-do list with Claude Duet on walks, instead of saving the work for his desk. Chelsea Larsson, who leads our model and product behavior design team, hands Claude Duet her to-do list before leaving to be with her kids and it saves the results for an evening report. And the team behind Claude Duet uses it to build the product. Karan Ahuja, who leads the team, works with it to schedule user interviews, partner with him on prototypes, and even ship code.

blocks.text: How Claude Duet works

inlines.text: How Claude Duet works

blocks.text: Your context from Claude is the foundation. Claude Duet carries over your memory, skills, and connected apps from your Claude account, so setting it up requires minimal work. What changes is how you work together: Claude Duet comes to you first, and you can message it through typing or voice in one ongoing thread, so a quick reply and a weeklong project both start in the same place.

inlines.text: Your context from Claude is the foundation.

Claude Duet carries over your memory, skills, and connected apps from your Claude account, so setting it up requires minimal work. What changes is how you work together: Claude Duet comes to you first, and you can message it through typing or voice in one ongoing thread, so a quick reply and a weeklong project both start in the same place.

blocks.text: Work continues when you step away. Claude Duet has a virtual machine with its own browser, so it doesn’t require your laptop or phone to be on. Describe a task in a short message, and it works out which apps to use and what steps to take in the background. You’ll receive a notification when the task is complete or needs your review.

blocks.text: Receive a message when something needs you. Claude Duet checks your connected accounts every few hours, because checking nonstop would use up your plan’s limits much faster. We’re continuing to test its judgment about when to message you, and we’ll keep tuning it based on what testers tell us. You can also tell it what you want to hear about and how often.

blocks.text: Important decisions stay with you. Claude Duet reads, drafts, and prepares work on its own. But before it sends a message, makes a payment, signs a document, or deletes anything, it shows you exactly what it’s about to do and waits for your approval. A few things are off-limits even with your approval, like trading securities or moving money between accounts. You’re also able to disconnect any app Claude Duet has access to.

blocks.text: Connect with the tools your business runs on. Claude Duet can use the over 6,000 connectors and plugins in the Claude Marketplace (opens in new tab) to:

inlines.text: Connect with the tools your business runs on.
Claude Duet can use the over 6,000 connectors and plugins in the
Claude Marketplace (opens in new tab)
to:
Find the Gmail and Slack messages you’ve missed and help you reply.
Check Intuit QuickBooks or Stripe for unpaid invoices and draft reminders.
Prepare and run payroll in Gusto, with hours, bonuses, and reimbursements filled in.
Draft a job posting and, once you edit and approve, post it to LinkedIn.
Help prepare agreements and send them for review and signature through Docusign.
Draft follow-up emails using the contact and deal history in HubSpot.
Turn your product launch into a social campaign in Canva.
Set up, design, and manage your Shopify store. Coming soon, a richer visual editor will let you design your storefront and preview it before anything goes live.

blocks.text: You can also use Claude Duet to purchase things for your business using Link, Stripe’s digital wallet. Claude Duet confirms the item with you, and Link asks you to approve the spend. It then pays with a virtual card, so your real card number isn’t shared. It can also use Shop Pay from Shopify to check out at online stores. Coming soon, with your permission, it will be able to sign in to sites with logins you’ve saved in 1Password.

blocks.text: This is an early version of Claude Duet, and it still might misread a thread or miscalibrate what’s urgent. We built its core functionality around work, so personal errands, such as booking tickets, aren’t quite as strong, and it can’t yet show you its browser. For now, Claude Duet lives in its own app, separate from the main Claude app. What we learn from early users will shape how the two work together.

blocks.text: During the research preview, Claude Duet shares your plan’s usage limits with the rest of Claude, and it uses them differently than a typical conversation does. Its background checks count toward those limits, and larger tasks, like building a financial model or a deck, require more model turns and background work.
